description: Referring domains for a target domain from the Common Crawl webgraph (4.4B edges, 120M domains). Returns linking domains ranked by CrawlGraph authority — useful for SEO audits, competitor backlink profiles, link-building gap research, and verifying who is citing a brand. One call = one quota credit.

domain.description: Target domain to look up (e.g., "example.com"). Bare host, no scheme.

limit.description: Max linking domains to return (default 1000, max 10000).

release_id.description: Optional Common Crawl release (e.g., "CC-MAIN-2026-04"). Default = latest. Use crawlgraph_releases to list.

sort.description: Sort by "authority" (default) or "hosts" (number of distinct linking hosts).

name: crawlgraph_backlinks
title: Crawlgraph Backlinks
